ceu: ✦ The trine between Mars and Neptune

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
From {H:1824231775000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between Mars and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Mars brings courage and initiative, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
From {H:1824231775000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The trine between Mars and Neptune brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Mars brings courage and initiative, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
From {H:1824231775000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between Mars and Neptune brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
From {H:1824231775000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The trine between Mars and Neptune brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Mars brings courage and initiative, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
